detail: the name this shape's position asks for is taken already, so it was given a numeric suffix; a `names` entry in the configuration can give it a better one
`exclusiveMinimum` is a boolean, which is the 3.0 form modifying a sibling `minimum`; 2020-12 has no boolean there, so it was rewritten as the numeric bound
the property may be absent and may be null, and the document says those are different; both become `None`, so a value that was explicitly null is written back as an absent member
`type` is not one of the seven JSON Schema types; the value is held as-is and typed as arbitrary JSON
`type` names more than one kind of value, which no single Rust type expresses

this union declares no discriminator and one of its branches says nothing about the shape of its own payload and is not the last, so it accepts the payloads meant for every branch after it, so nothing decides which branch a payload is; the value is typed as arbitrary JSON rather than matched against whichever branch happens to parse first

this union declares no discriminator and one of its branches is an object that accepts the payloads of a later one, which is tried after it and so never reached, so nothing decides which branch a payload is; the value is typed as arbitrary JSON rather than matched against whichever branch happens to parse first
